name: Lormetazepam

description: Lormetazepam is a benzodiazepine with strong sleep-inducing and calming effects, used for short-term treatment of severe insomnia. It starts working fairly quickly and stays in the body for a medium length of time, so it helps you fall asleep and stay asleep without too much next-day drowsiness for most people.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Lormetazepam is a benzodiazepine with strong hypnotic and sedative effects, indicated for short-term management of severe insomnia. It has a relatively rapid onset of action and an intermediate half-life, making it effective for sleep initiation and maintenance without excessive next-day sedation in most patients.
